Container.Name: Hades
Container.Overview: Hades is a self-hosted media management server and companion backend for Icarus. It centralizes supported media-service connections such as Sonarr, Radarr, and Seerr and provides a unified library for Icarus clients, including Apple TV. This is a community-maintained Unraid template; Hades itself is developed by the Pantheon/Icarus developers.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Icarus Sonarr Radarr Seerr media manager Pantheon
Container.Requires: Network access to the media services you configure in Hades.
Container.Changes: Initial Unraid Community Applications template release.

Config.Name: Hades Config
Config.Description: Persistent Hades configuration, databases, integration credentials, and library data.

Config.Name: Web/API Port
Config.Description: Port used by the Hades web interface, API, and Icarus clients.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by Hades. Change this to your local TZ database timezone if necessary.

Config.Name: Catalog Work Profile
Config.Description: Controls the Hades catalog worker profile. Balanced is the recommended general-purpose setting.

Config.Name: Local Recovery
Config.Description: Controls the Hades local recovery feature. Disabled by default.
